summary: Retested the two fixes from iteration_15 (paywall legal link tap-blocking + sign-in legal touch targets) at viewport 390x844 and ran a backend spot-check on /api/billing/checkout. BOTH FIXES VERIFIED. (1) PAYWALL: paywall-terms and paywall-privacy are now rendered INSIDE the sticky ctaBar below the paywall-purchase button. Bounding boxes: paywall-terms = 52.7x44 at y=776, paywall-privacy = 59.3x44 at y=776, paywall-purchase = 358x52 at y=712. document.elementFromPoint() at the center of each legal testID now returns a child DIV of the Pressable with the matching data-testid in its ancestor chain (hasOwnTid=true) — NOT the ctaBar wrapper. Real page.mouse.click() at the exact center coordinates (155,798 for Terms; 231,798 for Privacy) successfully navigates to /legal/terms (then back to /paywall) and /legal/privacy respectively. The paywall-purchase Continue button is NOT covered by the legal row (hasOwnTid=true at its center 195,738). (2) SIGN-IN: signin-terms = 42x44 at y=776, signin-privacy = 80x44 at y=776 — both meet the >=44 CSS px height requirement via legalTap { minHeight: 44, paddingVertical: 10 }. Real-tap navigation to /legal/terms and /legal/privacy both work. (3) BACKEND: POST /api/billing/checkout {plan:'monthly'} returned a cs_live_... Stripe Checkout URL (no regression). No new issues found; iteration_15 bugs are fully resolved.
